Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GOAL / EVIDENCE: Recover pavement from roadside obstacles and sustain travel toward the green arch. Actual objective, checkpoints, finish and completion remain unconfirmed. Screenshots are omitted; observations are prior agent descriptions and an older summary, whose final paragraph was truncated. Treat appearances as evidence only of described endpoints, not hidden mechanics, exact paths or progress. No terminal success reported.

LATEST OBSERVED STATE: Centered on dry pavement at 1 mph in gear 1; puddles ahead, red X visible, timer 59:59.000. The preceding W reduced displayed speed 3→1 with no visibly touching obstacle. A further 1-second W COMPLETED, but no subsequent observation was supplied. Its outcome is UNKNOWN; do not assume acceleration, maintained alignment or progress.

CONTROLS / EXECUTION: W=throttle/forward; repeatedly selects gear 1 from R. S=brake/reverse; can stop forward motion and select R. Older displayed maxima were 12 mph forward and 7 mph reverse. A/D are left/right steering inputs, but screen-relative response is unreliable, especially in reverse. Space was called handbrake: older Space+A from puddled pavement at 3 mph R ended stopped on grass in R; Space+D from tree-side pavement edge at 5 mph gear 1 also stopped on grass. This supports stopping with those combinations, not an isolated Space effect or reliable turning. Escape previously completed without a menu in the next view; effect unknown. Almost all inputs, including all in this continuation, lasted 1 second. One older 0.25-second W+A changed right-side open grass at 4 mph to centered dry pavement at 0; shorter steering reliability is untested. Rejected observation_age_limit inputs did NOT execute, and view changes after them cannot be attributed to them. New rejections: W+A at campsite grass 4 mph; S from stopped dry pavement. Older rejections included W+D on left grass, S+A among trees and W+A near a tent (the latter retried successfully). Completed execution does not prove intended maneuver success.

NAVIGATION: Puddled road visually leads toward green arch/banners, appearing upper-left or upper-right as views change; straight stretches and left/right bends recur. Trees closely line shoulders. Campsite grass contains white/red tents, campfire, white boulders/obstacles and older fallen sign/banners. Campsite often appears right of pavement and trees left, but this is view-relative, not a verified map. Pond has appeared both left and right during grass recoveries. Headlights and road direction are apparent alignment cues, not established heading. Repeated landmarks, apparent road crossings and abrupt view changes do not establish progress or reset. In this continuation the arch once appeared larger/nearer after W ended in a puddle at 1 mph, but the following W ended at the left road edge with the puddle ahead again.

HUD / MECHANICS: Timer repeatedly reads 59:59.000. Red X occurs moving/stopped and on grass/pavement; stops also occur without it. Two blue HUD dots recur in older history, meaning unknown. Red '+5s' has now been described on THREE transitions: (1) older W from dry pavement at 2 mph R ended pavement at 9 mph gear 1, right curve ahead, no X; (2) older second S+A from grassy shoulder 2 mph R ended centered dry pavement 5 mph R, headlights along road; (3) new W+D from among trees at 1 mph gear 1 ended dry pavement 8 mph, angled toward right shoulder, road upper-left, no X. These had substantially changed views; penalty/reset/respawn, trigger and timer behavior are UNCONFIRMED. Spray accompanies puddles. Puddles correlate with slowdowns but cannot explain all: W repeatedly slows/stops on dry pavement without a visibly touching obstacle. A puddle sometimes appears farther ahead after the car was within/immediately before it; repositioning is a hypothesis, not established. X is not reliable evidence of collision, immobilization or failure.

OLDER RECOVERY LESSONS: W+D/W+A and reverse steering alternately recovered pavement, crossed to opposite grass, or stopped among trunks/boulders. S+D often ended stopped among trees; W+A/S+A sometimes only changed gear. Two S near a boulder yielded 3 then 7 mph R; W then ended centered puddled pavement at 0 gear 1. Two S+A once reached puddled pavement at 3 R but headlights faced trees across the road. Space+A stopped off-road; W+A then W recovered centered dry pavement at 8, but later W stopped near a puddle. Other W runs gave dry-pavement 8→3→0 with X, and S then gave 2 R, showing movement remained possible there. These are occasional recoveries, not repeatable routes. Apparent alignment repeatedly failed to persist under straight W.

NEW CONTINUATION, INITIAL PAVEMENT RUN: Started campsite grass 4 mph gear 1, pavement left, white tent ahead-left, campfire right, no X. W+A was rejected; next view was stopped pavement beside small puddle with X, unexplained by that input. Seven completed W inputs then ended at: puddled pavement 6 X; centered pavement 7 no X; dry pavement 1 X; pavement 4 before large puddle no X; dry pavement 0 X with puddle farther ahead; dry pavement 5 X; dry pavement 0 X with clear gap before puddle. S was rejected. Next view was stopped left pavement edge, puddle ahead, trees left, X.

NEW TREE / POND LOOP: From that left edge, W+D ended grassy left edge 5 X; W recovered centered pavement 8 no X; W ended puddle 1 no X with arch apparently nearer; W ended left pavement edge 2 X. Two W+D ended left grass 2 no X, then stopped among trees with pavement right and X. S gave 1 R among trunks; S gave 0 R; S+A remained 0 R, view changed but clearance unconfirmed. Three W+D ended grass 4 gear 1 partly obscured by trunk; open grass left of road 5; then grass 5 with pavement behind, trees ahead and pond right (X throughout). S next ended centered pavement 4 R, facing along road, no X. W selected gear 1 at 4 near left pavement edge beside small white rock, X. W ended left grass 6, pond left/road right, no X.
